reviews.text: The team at Marina Veterinary Clinic are fantastic. We brought in our two cats, and they were so well cared for. The team there clearly love animals, and gave thoughtful, practical advice.

I cannot thank Jemma and Niall enough  for the  time and wonderful care given  to   my Stafford  this past week . I  had  attended Village Vets with her and was not happy at all with them . Luckily  I got an appointment with Marina Vets  I was listened too ,  she was  thoroughly checked over  and booked in for a scan  which showed she had pyometra so surgery was needed straight away . Your follow up phone call and  appointments  to check on her recovery were very much appreciated .   Wonderful practice with a fabulous team  . I am extremely grateful  to you all  .

Marina Vets

It was so lovely to meet Kelly-Ann again at Marina Vets. She really is the heart of the business and her love for the animals shines through. ❤️

Nala was absolutely spoilt with treats, cuddles and attention, including Kelly-Ann sitting on the floor playing with her. It was so lovely to see that genuine care and affection.

Gemma was fantastic too. Everything was explained so clearly, including what the next steps will be, which gave us great reassurance.

The welcome, warmth and genuine care that the animals receive at Marina Vets is truly heartwarming. You can tell that the people here genuinely love what they do and, most importantly, really care about the animals in their care.

I’m so glad I was told about Marina Vets. Nala and Chloe definitely approve! 🐾❤️
When you try a new vet and want to make sure it’s the best for your beautiful Poppy. The service is amazing and toy know your dog is safe and sound and then… they leave this message 🥰🥰🥰 …
Great vets. Friendly, professional and most importantly, independent.  Highly recommend.
Can't thank Niall.  Kelly Ann and Gemma enough for the wonderful job they did on my 14 year old dog.  It was a journey but with the dedication of these amazing people my dog is well again ❤️
I would highly recommend Marina Vets, they are an honest and genuine animal loving company, there’s not many vets left like this these days.
Wonderful staff! My dog loves coming here and is so well looked after ❤️

I was with a good vet previously who got taken over by Village Vets. The costs went up and personalised care went down. I heard about Marina Vets through a family member and checked them out. The reviews looked good! I decided to check them out. Best decision ever. They are attentive, super personal and I feel my dog is being cared for. Highly recommend!

Sarah and Niall (& Kelly-Anne) have looked after our Frenchies (Rodney & Séamus) for years now and couldn't speak more highly of them. Séamus suffered with uncontrolled epilepsy and Sarah put so much time into him. Rodney's also had his issues with allergies, eyes and everything in between and both Niall and Sarah have always been amazing with him

The best vet in cork no doubt!
Cannot recommend the team enough. The service is second to none, they are all so friendly and caring of both humans and pups! Cannot thank Gemma and Kelly-Ann enough!
5 Stars from Buzz!
Thanks guys
Simply the best vet in Cork
Everyone at Marina Vets are very friendly and welcoming. The premises are bright and really clean and very spacious 😃 …
so friendly and careful with my little baby (cat)

The team at Marina Vets are a credit to their profession, the love and care they showed our two dogs was out standing. Thank you all,
Tony & Lucia.

I transferred my Great Dane here from another vet as I felt I was not being listened to or taken seriously. Sarah and Niall took onboard my concerns and made a plan for my dog immediately with medication and a referral for a CT. I now finally have some long awaited answers thanks to Marina Vets! They are compassionate, friendly and very hardworking, following up with me by phone which was very thoughtful and took speedy action with my dogs care plan. Thank you so much again and I’d highly recommend this Vet practice!

One of the best vets in Cork. Sarah looked after my Golden Retriever when he was unwell with a heart condition and she was absolutely amazing. She genuinely cares about the animals and always goes above and beyond. I’ve since returned with our newest addition (a Cockapoo) and the care has been excellent again. Sarah, Niall and all the team are so kind, professional and helpful — I couldn’t recommend them highly enough. If you’re thinking of going to them, do it — you won’t regret it.

I would be amazed if there are more caring and professional vets in Cork than Sarah, Niall and Kelly-Ann. They love animals and are so caring and kind. I cannot thank them enough for looking after our dog. Highly recommend
Great vet's kelly Ann is great to deal with

Went to Marina Veterinary Clinic today and met Niall. A sound guy who gave me some great advice and cared really well for my cat. Fair prices too and an independent Veterinary clinic worth supporting!
Lovely clinic, very calm and quiet in there and vet Sarah was lovely. My cat Callie was nervous but everything was very chill and quick, and she was happy to get a few treats as well!
Excellent service and customer service.Highly recommended

Independent vet clinic newly opened. The 2 vets running it are the owners. Reception is manned by someone who always takes an interest in the furry visitors and will invariably come out from behind the desk to meet the patient. Reception is bright and airy. Prices seem reasonable to me in comparison with the big veterinary chain clinics. Am very happy with the service.

My first time going to the marina vets and it was a five star experience. Super welcoming and highly knowledgeable staff. Delighted to have found a private vets practice where I know my dog will be very well looked after.
Excellent care, great location and great parking!. My bulldog happily trots in for her visits

One of the best vets in Cork City – kind, compassionate, and our dog Luna is always butt wagging with happiness to visit. They’ve been with us from day one, and we feel very lucky. Highly recommend, especially for new dog owners.

Thanks Sarah, Niall and Kelly Anne

Lovely caring people.
Can't praise them enough.
My 12 year old cat had to get an eye removed.
The care and attention she got was just fantastic.
She's like a new cat and I would recommend  them highly.
Thank ye so much
Could not recommend Marina Vets enough, Sarah, Niall and Kelly-Anne are just fab. It is all about the animal, and the  standard of care is second to none.  Thank you Marina Vets
Brought my dog there for the first time. Very thorough examination and explanation

Sarah has looked after our dog twice now and we're so glad we switched over to Marina Vets.
Really professional & knowledgeable but also very reassuring that our dog was in good hands.
The team here are a pleasure to deal with - so friendly, caring and reliable. Would highly recommend. Very easy access/parking outside too and great location.

Omg so nice, spacious,
Staff real chatty really make you feel at ease will be going back

Can’t recommend Niall enough, helped us at an incredibly difficult time with a pet dog. He was so courteous at welcoming us out of hours on a Sunday morning and had a diagnosis for the dog within moments and put us at ease. Sadly it was the dogs time and she didn’t make it, but Niall’s empathy and patience to allow us see her after she passed will be something we will forever be grateful for. We were given all the time and space we needed to say a proper goodbye and Niall looked after all arrangements as efficiently as you could want. If you’re ever in this situation god forbid, I can’t think of a safer pair of hands for your pet to be in.

Niall went to great lengths this weekend to help us with an emergency appointment for our puppy. He was very reassuring, helpful, and treated our dog with kindness and care. We will be coming back to Marina Veterinary for any of our future needs. Thank you!
Great vets
Couldn't recommend Marina Vets enough. Niall, Sarah and Kelly-Ann were kind, informative and supportive when my little fellow was having a medical emergency, and went above and beyond to help.

I couldn't recommend this vets more! I have been taking my dog to Sarah and Niall for the last number of years and followed them to this new clinic. My dog is fairly old and has had quite a few medical problems and a big surgery. They have always taken the time to explain everything to me so I understand my options and how best to look after my dog with her treatments. Kellyanne is wonderful and so welcoming - putting my dog at ease as soon as she comes in.  They are a dream team - they love animals and have my full trust.
What a great place to take your pet they love they show for the pets and family is Outstanding .and great value to.well done to all the team there 👏 . …

Great experience in the Marina Veterinary clinic.
Sarah and all the staff are very helpful, kind and caring towards both the animals and their owners.
Have dealt with Niall before. He went above and beyond for us. He was nothing short of amazing. Will be following him to Marina vet clinic without any hesitation. Highly recommended.

Sarah, Niall and Kelly-Ann are the best Vetinary Team in Cork by far, at Marina Vets you and your pet will experience a welcome like no other and a level of exceptional care for your animal. A modern state of the art Clinic, love that its got free easy parking and right beside the marina market. Such exceptional services and made affordable too. Great to see our own Cork Vets opening up and providing such high standard in Vetinary care in Cork.
Would highly recommend Marina Vets to anyone in Cork with a pet. These guys really do love animals ❤️❤️❤️
Emer O’Callaghan
Emerald Beauty Clinic
Echo Beauty Expert

Nial and his staff are so friendly and helpful
Amazing care and attention towards the animals and their owners

Sarah and Niall are so incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. I wouldn’t trust my beloved pets with anyone else but Marina Veterinary Clinic. Kelly-Ann is a breath of fresh air; her friendly attitude and professionalism make me feel so welcome. Their genuine love for animals truly shines through!
